text:
maya: Heads up — Solara Labs renewal is due next week. Procurement sent an addendum request: 5% discount and SLA change from 99.95% -> 99.9%. They also requested net60. They want Docusign. CCing @raj for billing and @lisa_legal for review.

raj: Got it. Do we have final seat counts? They asked to lock at 100 seats. Any capacity concerns if they spike after renewal?

tim_ops: Capacity looks fine for steady state at 100. If they burst we'll handle via burst pool but that needs Dedicated plan confirmed. Finance will weigh net60.

lisa_legal: 5% discount needs sales leadership approval. SLA downgrade (99.95 -> 99.9) is actually a relaxation in our favor? procurement wording is odd — need to confirm intent. I'll draft an SLA addendum and point out maintenance windows. Any data ingress/PII flags?

maya: No PII. They use hosted API only. Procurement specifically said CFO will sign. They'll want the signed doc returned via Docusign.

raj: I'll reach out to their procurement lead and CFO. Also can we offer an onboarding enablement session to sweeten the deal (teams ramp) — propose 2 training sessions included.

tim_ops: From ops side fine with training. Finance note: net60 increases DSO impact; suggest invoice split 50/50 (first 50% on signing, remainder 30 days after start) as a compromise.

lisa_legal: Drafted clause for addendum, see snippet below. Need someone from sales to OK the discount.

```
SLA ADDENDUM: Provider commits to 99.95% uptime per calendar month. Scheduled maintenance will be communicated 72 hours in advance and excluded from availability calculations.
```

deploy-bot: Docusign envelope created (DS-12345). Status: created. Link: https://docusign.example/DS-12345

maya: Thanks — @raj can you confirm signer name/email by EOD so we can populate envelope? Also please update SFDC stage to renewal:pending-addendum. I booked enablement for 2026-05-12 pending seat confirmation.

raj: CFO confirmed: Emma Li (emma.li@solara.com). I'll update the envelope and ping finance for invoice split approval. Will also ask for PO if they want net60.

maya: Perfect. If sales leadership approves the 5% I'll send final addendum to Docusign. Marking follow-ups: legal review complete, finance signoff on invoice split, procurement PO or CC decision, and onboarding seat confirmation. :thumbsup:
